thread:
sam: Quick heads-up: we're kicking off a Community Maintainers Retreat CFP today. Dates: Jul 14-15, 2025 (hybrid). Apply here: https://forms.gle/retainers-cfp. Travel stipends available (up to $800), more details below.

jess: yay! what's the cutoff?

sam: CFP closes Jun 25, 11:59pm PT. We'll pick ~18 talks/workshops + a few stipend recipients.

kai: will remote folks get access to recordings?

olivia: yes, recordings + slides will be published in the community repo; short summaries will go in the blog. We'll include captions.

jenna: can we nominate contributors focused on docs/translations?

sam: for sure. The form has a nominates section; self-noms welcome.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Community Maintainers Retreat (Hybrid)"  Jul 14 09:00  Jul 15 17:00 PDT. Link: https://calendar.example/event/67890

dan: logistics q: how are stipends paid internationally?

mia: ops note: US folks via ACH/Stripe; intl via invoice or wire. We'll confirm payment method during selection; some countries may need forms.

alex: are external community contributors eligible for stipend?

sam: yes; primary criteria is demonstrated impact/contributions. The CFP asks for repo links, community activities, or project proposals.

jess: I'll drop a blurb in the weekly newsletter and crosspost to #community-events.

olivia: adding a pinned discussion in the Maintainers handbook repo and a GitHub Discussions post.

sam: Code of Conduct applies; stipend recipients must accept COC and optional accessibility accommodation form. DM if you have safety concerns.

contributor-bot: Reminder scheduled: CFP closes in 3 weeks (Jun 25).

sam: TL;DR: CFP open -> Jun 25. Apply: https://forms.gle/retainers-cfp. Hybrid + recordings. Stipends limited  apply even if unsure. Ping @olivia or me with Qs. :sparkles:

jess: :thumbsup:
